text:
anya: Quick idea — let's add a hover preview on the per-call line in Cost Explorer that shows 'predicted marginal token cost if routed to X' so PMs can compare routing decisions without running sims.
mike: nice. are the signals available in telemetry to compute that on the fly? we need route + cache-hit-prob + model-sku to estimate marginal per-token.
sara: we do have route and model_sku, cache-hit is sampled. worrying about noise if we show live numbers. maybe show a 95% CI + sample size? :thinking_face: 
jordan: backend: we don't currently emit a prefetch_credit or warmup_hit estimate per invocation. we could derive from prefix_cache_kv_hit but that's expensive to join in the pipeline.
anya: rough sketch — hover shows: current route cost, alt route cost (est.), delta, confidence, and 'cache-warmup penalty' estimate. clickable 'run sim' to queue a sim job.
mike: API debate: should the frontend ask our new /econ/estimate endpoint (fast, approximate) or call /telemetry/query and compute locally? prefer server compute to keep UI simple.
sara: +1 server compute. also need an opt-out for low-sample metrics. UX should show 'estimated' badge and tooltip explaining sample bias.
jordan: impl note — proto change needed: add float prefetch_credit_est, int sample_count to TelemetryEvent. small proto diff:
```
message TelemetryEvent {
  string route = 1;
  string model_sku = 2;
  float prefetch_credit_est = 12; // new
  int64 sample_count = 13;       // new
}
```
anya: can we stub it and roll back if we see perf issues? we need a canary in Console.
econ-bot: [alert] cost-insight: high variance in route 'canary-3' — sample_count < 50 in last hour.
mike: ok i'll draft the /econ/estimate shape and a console mock. will ping infra for pipeline join cost.
sara: i'll draft tooltip copy and 2-line explainer for PMs. she/her. :rocket: 
anya: thanks — sync at 3pm to decide API shape.
